cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Dad, will you come to my opening? Even for ten minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You survived every school play. I still want you in my corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother will be there. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come before we open. I'll unpack the biggest piece with you. I want a memory of tonight with you in it too.

mechanism: A copies a social or practical custom incorrectly to seem at home, then uses new clues to persuade B to stay involved as proof of connection.
confusable: D74 delays departure until repair; D73 asks presence/help as proof connection still matters, without requiring a quarrel.
comparison: Shared activity between rarely meeting friends versus father at an art opening.
seedUse: Preserve B vulnerability or social discomfort as an opportunity for a more workable shared role.
